name: Lumos
name_zh: 鹿明机器人科技（深圳）有限公司
summary:
Lumos Robotics develops embodied-intelligence robots for industrial deployment. Its portfolio includes the LUS full-size bipedal humanoid, MOS heavy-duty wheeled dual-arm robot, NIX mini humanoid and LUD wheeled-legged platform. These different forms address varying requirements for reach, mobility and physical work.

The company connects robot development with data gathered from practical industrial settings. Its public materials describe partnerships with companies including Mitsubishi Electric Intelligent Manufacturing in China and COSCO SHIPPING. Lumos emphasizes bringing embodied AI into repeatable commercial use, combining the physical platforms with the application work and operational experience needed for deployment.
